title: A new folder under .dd/ needs four places updated
body: When adding a folder or file under .dd/, update every place that names them in the same change: operationPath's whitelist in src/store/transactions.js (a journaled write outside it fails with invalid_journal_path), DERIVED_ENTRIES in src/memory/ignore.js when it is derived (or it lands in git), localPaths in src/engine/locate.cjs, and the table in docs/guide/storage.md. The Codex installer's ignore list (scripts/install-codex.mjs) and `deltadictum init` write the same entries. Why: in v1 the journal whitelist was the one place a plan missed, and the first write failed with invalid_journal_path; the ignore list and the docs fail silently, which is worse.
not_derivable: The whitelist fails loudly; that the ignore list and the storage table must move with it is written nowhere near them.

evidence.summary: operationPath accepts journal paths under an explicit list.
